statement: Separate operational mission command, ship/base air-ops control, airborne tactical command, and fighter-direction control.
Communication maturity makes authority boundary explicit: below sets objective/priority/reserve/broad vector; airborne leader owns local geometry/attack execution after contact.
Layered strike command: overall airborne leader -> type/mission leaders -> tactical-package leaders -> shotai leaders.
CAP remains shared-control longer: below sector/vector/reinforcement/relief; airborne leader intercept geometry/engagement/cover/reform.
Force air staff, carrier captain, air-group staff, deck/hangar ops and plot/fighter-control functions are distinct even if personnel overlap; no invented modern CIC.
Force staff best operational picture; ship plot best local warning; airborne leader best tactical picture; package/shotai leader best immediate maneuver picture.
Operational command minutes-hours; ship-air retask tens sec-minutes; airborne package command seconds-tens sec. Ship exact-geometry orders can be stale.
Below-side states B0-B3; B2 normal pre-contact/B3 temporary with coherent warning; no precision B4.
Airborne states A0-A3; A2 normal prepared unit/A3 possible early coordinated phase; dense combat degrades.
Track mission->air leader, plot->leader, leader->package, package->shotai, air status/BDA->below; failure is often latency/ambiguity/stale info rather than generic incompetence.
Below prebriefs FT/Type91/D3A roles; airborne leaders choose actual screen-vs-carrier suppression target from current geometry.
